title: Interview speaker card over a synthetic presenter
caption: The interview-speaker-card recipe: a split frame with left-aligned name, role and episode topic on a brand panel while the speaker stays visible on the right, to open an interview or podcast clip.
prompt: I have a talking-head clip (synthetic here: make it with node make-footage.mjs, presenter on the right half). Add an interview speaker card in the interview-speaker-card style for 4.5 seconds near the start: kicker "The Magnifito podcast", name "Mira", role "Social media lead, Magnifito", topic "Episode 3: Posting with a plan". The presenter is fictional, so record the name and role in claims.json as placeholders. Render the card transparent and lay it over the footage. Logo on the panel (assets/magnifito-logo.svg). Brand: cream panel, warm browns, dark ink, green #8acf31 accent, Geist from fonts/.
commands: ffmpeg -i work/source.mp4 -itsoffset 0.75 -i work/overlay.mov -filter_complex "[0:v][1:v]overlay=eof_action=pass:format=auto,format=yuv420p[v]" -map [v] -map 0:a -t 6 -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset medium -c:a aac -b:a 160k work/interview-speaker-card.mp4
credits: Geist typeface by Vercel, SIL Open Font License 1.1 (fonts/OFL-Geist.txt); TTF converted from the WOFF2 vendored in vendor/barty-motion-graphics
Presenter, room and voice-like tone track generated by make-footage.mjs and presenter.mjs (no third-party media)
Magnifito logo (assets/magnifito-logo.svg, from the Magnifito website): owned by Magnifito, the demo client; used with permission
